_why: The mirror of toolify's near miss, and the one the trace says the town actually fails: run 28 spent 45% of its turn spend in turns that ran to the call limit, one act per call, doing the same round every morning. A routine repeated four mornings is worth a NAME - `toolify` keeps it and can be revised - and running it unnamed again is the cheap move that never compounds.
open_question_to_me: Fell, carry to the mill, craft planks, sell: you have done exactly this on each of the last four mornings, and you are starting it again now.
